segments.text: Imprisoned in a cave, covered over by much,
the man stands who is immersed in delusion.
Such a one is far indeed from seclusion
for sensual pleasures in the world are not easy to abandon.
Tied down to want, bound to the pleasure of existing,
they are hard to free, not freeable by others.
Now looking behind, now looking ahead,
they hanker now after these, now after the former pleasures.
they are incorrigible, entered upon an uneven path.
“What shall we become when we fall away from this.”
